apiKey.label: OpenAirLog API key
apiKey.help: A read-only OpenAirLog API key with the flights:read permission.

homebase.label: Homebase (IATA)
homebase.help: Three-letter IATA airport code, e.g. FRA for Frankfurt or MUC for Munich.

flightScnrPiUpdateUrl.label: FlightScnrPi Update URL
flightScnrPiUpdateUrl.help: HTTPS URL of the server endpoint that receives the current flight number.

flightScnrPiUrl.label: FlightScnrPi JSON URL
flightScnrPiUrl.help: URL of the currentFlight.json file that FlightScnrPi can read.

flightScnrPiToken.label: FlightScnrPi token
flightScnrPiToken.help: Secret token used to authenticate the FlightScnrPi update endpoint.
